To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we isolated 14 actinomycete strains from mangrove samples in Macau, one of the strains, Streptomyces strain, was selected for genome mining, and 109 gene clusters for secondary metabolite biosynthesis were identified, among them, two secondary metabolites were identified from ethyl acetate extraction of fermentation broth.

1) a novel strain of Streptomyce was isolated from a mangrove ecosystem and identified based on the analysis of its 16S rDNA and genome sequences; 2) this strain was predicted to produce a wide array of bioactive secondary metabolite, including melanin and desfeiromamine B, both of which were firstly identified from this species; 3) the genome mining approach was proved to be an efficient method to identify the bioactive compounds produced by this strain

the isolated Streptomycetes sp. contains 8,348 kb genome, which encodes for 109 gene clusters, and the genome mining revealed that the strain is capable to produce 14 different types of secondary metabolites.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the isolation and identification of actinomycete strains from a mangrove ecosystem in Macau.
the identification, genome mining, and metabolite analysis of the isolated strain, which may be useful as a potential antibiotic producer.
the discovery of new antibiotics from mangrove-derived Streptomyces.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the genome guided investigation of the isolated actinomycete from the Macau mangrove is a promising strategy for the discovery of novel natural products.
the genome-guided investigation of mangrove-derived actins is a powerful strategy to discover novel bioactive compounds and their biosynthetic pathways.
the genome-guided investigation of mangrove-derived actionmycetes is a promising approach to discover novel antibiotics.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the isolated Streptomycetes sp. has the potential to produce novel bioactive secondary metabolite and could be a promising candidate for the production of bioactive natural products.
the isolated strain from the mangrove in Macao could be a potential source of novel antibiotics.
the genome mining of mangrove-derived actionmycetes is a promising approach to discover novel antibiotics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mangrove ecosystem is an underexplored habitat for actinomycete strains, which may contain novel secondary metabolites.
actinomycete species isolated from mangrove ecosystems are a rich source of novel bioactive compounds.
mangrove actinomycete strains can be used as potential resources to discover novel bioactive secondary metabolite compounds.
